calls.thesis: Innodata: price slipped below bottom rung of signal ladder; re-review still checks out but no clear setup now. Record quarter (sales +58%), profits expected +27% next year, stock -15% since July at ~half June peak. Condition: hold off until early-November earnings; only riskiest slice of money, very small, add a little over time. First tracked BWB call on INOD.
calls.base_case: Neutrality vs Scale AI (half-owned by Meta) protects it as rivals shun a competitor-owned vendor.
calls.bull_case: Robot motion-data lab and US government AI testing are potential next growth legs, not yet in numbers.
calls.bear_case: Two big-tech customers = ~71% of sales; CEO changed end-September; up to $300M new stock sale plan caps rallies; 10%+ single-day moves 15 times this year.
